phone.changelog: A refreshed cream-and-forest design, clearer navigation, readable cards and consistent controls throughout. Real captured health records with original timestamps; clearly labeled estimates and unavailable states. Removes fabricated readiness, sleep stages and workout heart-rate zones. Adds accurate workout history and exports, improved face previews, and verified updates. Install both phone and watch apps.

watch.changelog: A consistent dark-and-mint design across menus, settings, workouts, faces and health pages, with visible Back and Clock controls. Real sensor capture, honest missing values and clear capture status. Removes generated oxygen/stress/sleep values. Adds motion-rest estimates, guided breathing, manual hydration, reliable compass states, stricter steps/heart-rate capture and verified updates. Install both apps; unverifiable legacy live step counts restart after upgrade.
